svg.title: Tenant boundary
svg.desc: Each tenant gets its own directory tree, its own hash-chained audit chain and its own erasure scope; console routes take the tenant from the authenticated session, never from env vars; gateway runs are rate-limited per tenant.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Five-scope model (task · session · project · user · tenant). Default tenant: _default.
